mcp.read.new.output.while.the.session.is.en: Read new output while the session is running. Supply next_cursor from the previous read; wait_ms can long-poll for output.
mcp.read.new.output.while.the.session.is.zh-CN: 读取运行中会话的新输出。传入上次读取返回的 next_cursor；wait_ms 可用于长轮询。

mcp.wait.up.to.this.many.milliseconds.fo.en: Wait up to this many milliseconds for output
mcp.wait.up.to.this.many.milliseconds.fo.zh-CN: 等待输出的最长时间，单位毫秒

mcp.send.input.to.a.running.session.incl.en: Send input to a running session. Include a newline to answer a prompt; input may be echoed in the terminal output.
mcp.send.input.to.a.running.session.incl.zh-CN: 向运行中的会话发送输入。回答提示时请包含换行符；输入可能回显在终端输出中。

mcp.input.bytes.as.text.e.g.yes.n.en: Input bytes as text, e.g. yes\n
mcp.input.bytes.as.text.e.g.yes.n.zh-CN: 以文本表示的输入字节，例如 yes\n

mcp.create.a.client.connection.token.and.en: Create a client connection token and a 15-minute invitation. Set multi_device=true for multiple simultaneous devices and a reusable invitation; otherwise the invitation is single-use and only one device may connect. First show display_text including both platform commands, then poll list_clients using client_token. Use client_id to target devices for multi-device tokens. Session tools use session_id after starting a session. If commands are unavailable, explain that a release build is required. Treat tokens and commands as credentials and share privately.
mcp.create.a.client.connection.token.and.zh-CN: 创建客户端连接 Token 和 15 分钟有效的邀请。设置 multi_device=true 可让多台设备同时在线且邀请可重复兑换；否则邀请仅可兑换一次、仅允许一台设备在线。先展示包含两个平台命令的 display_text，再使用 client_token 轮询 list_clients。多设备 Token 通过 client_id 选择设备，启动会话后通过 session_id 操作。命令不可用时说明需要发布版。Token 和命令均为凭据，请私密分享。

mcp.target.client.connection.token.requi.en: Target client connection token (required when authenticated with the management key)
mcp.target.client.connection.token.requi.zh-CN: 目标客户端连接 Token（使用管理密钥认证时必填）

client.already.connected.to.server.en: This account already has a connection to this server on this computer. Disconnect the existing client before reconnecting.
client.already.connected.to.server.zh-CN: 当前账户在本机已有到此服务器的连接，请先断开已有客户端，再重新连接。

mcp.list.clients.en: List currently online devices belonging to this client_token. After creating a token, first show display_text to the user, then poll list_clients at reasonable intervals until the desired devices appear. Use their client_id to execute commands or start sessions. Returns an empty clients array when none are online.
mcp.list.clients.zh-CN: 列出当前 client_token 下在线的设备。创建 Token 后先展示 display_text，再以合理间隔轮询 list_clients，直到所需设备出现。使用返回的 client_id 执行命令或启动会话。没有设备在线时返回空 clients 数组。

mcp.client.id.en: Six lowercase letters or digits from list_clients. Required for multi-device tokens, even when only one device is online; optional for single-device tokens.
mcp.client.id.zh-CN: list_clients 返回的 6 位小写字母或数字 ID。多设备 Token 必填，即使只有一台设备在线；单设备 Token 可省略。

mcp.multi.device.en: Allow multiple devices to connect simultaneously and reuse the invitation until it expires. Default false.
mcp.multi.device.zh-CN: 允许多台设备同时在线，并在邀请有效期内重复兑换。默认 false。

unknown.client.id.en: Unknown or offline client_id for this token.
unknown.client.id.zh-CN: 此 Token 下没有该 client_id，或设备已离线。

client.id.required.en: client_id is required for multi-device tokens. Call list_clients to select a device.
client.id.required.zh-CN: 多设备 Token 必须提供 client_id，请调用 list_clients 选择设备。

multi.device.display.notice.en: Multi-device token: multiple devices may connect simultaneously. The invitation commands can be reused for 15 minutes.
multi.device.display.notice.zh-CN: 多设备 Token：允许多台设备同时在线，一键连接命令可在 15 分钟内重复使用。

connection.retry.en: Connection lost or failed (online %s): %s. Retry #%d in %s.
connection.retry.zh-CN: 连接断开或失败（已连接 %s）：%s。第 %d 次重试将在 %s 后开始。
